Predicting the wind direction to stabilize a ship\nis...ugh! A technique that only the goddess of\nWind, Stormia can do! I've never learned that!!
Hey!\nYou're the god that ensures voyage safety,\naren't you?! Can't you do something...?
Navie's not gonna wake up while the ark is\nflying...Oh no no no! Because she's the one that\nis powering the ark.
Whaaat?!\nI don't get it at all!!\nWhat do you mean?!
That box is a power reactor! By staying inside,\nNavie can convert various forces that exist in\nairspace into power to move the ark...
I remember hearing that from Stormia...\nThat's all.\nDon't ask me why cuz I dunno!!
Whoa, look!!\nThat's what the empress...Coenubia was using...
I've been waiting for this moment...\nYou all are gonna die here!!
Whoa?! You look just like the Elf wizard in\nGravel Terrace that turned into a monster\nbut...seem more dangerous and powerful!!
She's got amorphous structures all over her\nbody...She seems more powerful than the monster\nbeing controlled by crystals in Gravel Terrace.
We'll take care of this thing,\njust focus on steering the ark, okay?!
Oh no! If we don't do something, Reliza will be\ndevoured by the Coenubia and disappear!
Heyyyyy! Where are you guys goingggg?!
